english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that you will try or make an effort.
Use this everyday choice when asking someone to sample food or drink.
Use this for casually trying something out to see what happens, rather than carrying out a formal study.

examples.english: Let's attempt to fix the old computer.
examples.traditional: 我哋試吓整返部舊電腦。

examples.english: Taste this iced lemon tea first.
